searchText: This is perhaps a dumb question, but what happens when `BASE FEE` + `GAS PREMIUM` is smaller than `FEE CAP`? Does the difference get refunded to the user, or does it get added to `GAS PREMIUM` ? Also, would it be possible for wallets to dynamically (i.e. without signing another tx) adjust the `GAS PREMIUM` if a user only specifies a `FEE CAP` or would it always require re-signing because it'd be a new txn? > This is perhaps a dumb question, but what happens when `BASE FEE` + `GAS PREMIUM` is smaller than `FEE CAP`? Does the difference get refunded to the user, or does it get added to `GAS PREMIUM` ? <@!552133098075193354> my understanding is right now it gets added to `GAS PREMIUM` but an implementer should keep me honest here. Thanks! Yeah, I'm curious how the implementation could do that without re-signing the txn and, even though it intuitively feels like the simplest thing, is it the best? Would it be better to refund the sender or do we accept that FEECAP is a "promised spend"? <@552133098075193354> Refunded. You need to sign again if you change any transaction parameters. None of them are malleable.
